title: Spectral Indistinguishability and Learning-Curve Identifiability in Quadratic Networks
abstract: arXiv:2610.20678v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study what spectral summaries and scalar learning curves reveal about centered quadratic networks. We construct analytic positive input densities with exactly Gaussian one- and two-coordinate marginals. Their complete fourth-moment operators are intertwined by an orthogonal map fixing the entire diagonal teacher algebra, so the corresponding anchored spectral measures agree. For selected common teachers with a nonzero cycle invariant, their factorized loss curves differ because the map does not preserve matrix multiplication. Cycle length $r$, which can be arbitrarily large, gives $O(\varepsilon^r)$ contrast uniformly in training time for each fixed construction. For a supplied pair, noisy scalar loss queries require order $\varepsilon^{-2r}$ observations, while bounded initialization interventions with scalar gradient readouts require order $\varepsilon^{-2}$. translated_title: 二次网络中的谱不可区分性与学习曲线可辨识性
translated_abstract: 我们研究谱摘要和标量学习曲线能揭示中心化二次网络的哪些信息。我们构造了具有精确高斯单坐标和双坐标边缘分布的解析正输入密度。它们的完整四阶矩算子被一个固定整个对角教师代数的正交映射所交织，因此相应的锚定谱测度完全一致。对于具有非零循环不变量的选定常见教师，由于该映射不保持矩阵乘法，其因子化损失曲线则有所不同。循环长度 $r$ 可以任意大，对于每个固定构造，在训练时间内一致地给出 $O(\varepsilon^r)$ 的对比度。对于给定的网络对，带噪声的标量损失查询需要 $\varepsilon^{-2r}$ 量级的观测，而带标量梯度读出的有界初始化干预则需要 $\varepsilon^{-2}$ 量级的观测。一个等于配对梯度差的共享输入分数，能够达到……
tldr: 该论文构造了谱测度完全一致（谱不可区分）但学习曲线仍可区分的二次网络对，证明谱摘要无法唯一辨识网络，而标量学习曲线可以实现辨识，且其查询复杂度随循环长度呈指数增长。
en_tdlr: The paper constructs spectrally indistinguishable pairs of quadratic networks whose learning curves remain identifiable, demonstrating that spectral summaries cannot uniquely identify networks while scalar learning curves can, with query complexity growing exponentially in the cycle length.
